# Every documented command provides help without requiring an initialized board.
exec tuck$exe init --help
stdout 'Usage: tuck init'
! stderr .+
exec tuck$exe list --help
stdout 'Usage: tuck list'
exec tuck$exe show --help
stdout 'Usage: tuck show'

stdout 'Usage: tuck find'
exec tuck$exe recent --help
stdout 'Usage: tuck recent'

stdout 'Usage: tuck add'
